name: compute_balanced_ration
description: MANDATORY for final ration advice. Runs least-cost linear programming on 270+ feed library with INAPH minimum nutrition. Call ONLY after you have asked the farmer the price per kilogram for EVERY feed (or they said pata nahi for that feed). Returns kilogram/day per feed and total daily cost — do NOT read per-feed prices aloud.

lang.description: Language code: hi, en, gu, mr, etc.

weight_kg.description: Body weight in kg, estimate if unknown

calvings.description: Number of calvings / times bachha hua

in_milk.description: True if animal is giving milk now

feeds_json.description: JSON array of feeds farmer uses. MUST include price_rs (rupees per kilogram) for each feed after asking the farmer. If farmer says pata nahi for a feed, omit price_rs and set price_unknown: true. Example: [{"name":"hybrid napier ghaas","qty_kg":5,"price_rs":2},{"name":"sarson khali","qty_kg":1.5,"price_rs":18}]

neighborhood_feeds_json.description: On second call: local feeds farmer can get. Ask price per kilogram for each before calling. Example: [{"name":"hybrid napier ghaas","price_rs":2}] or price_unknown: true if pata nahi.

local_feed_names.description: Easier alternative on second call: comma-separated local feed names the farmer said, e.g. hybrid napier grass
